content.user_title: Audit SEO Performance and Ranking Issues
content.value_statement: SEO problems often hide across crawlability, page structure, content depth, and international signals. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a prioritized website audit.
actual_capabilities: Asks for site context, priority keywords, recent changes, competitors, and analytics access.
Checks crawlability, indexation, robots.txt, XML sitemaps, canonicals, redirects, and site architecture.
Reviews title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URL structure, internal links, and content alignment.
Evaluates Core Web Vitals, mobile readiness, HTTPS, caching, image optimization, and JavaScript impact.
Audits hreflang, locale canonicals, international sitemaps, and translated content quality.
Produces an executive summary, issue evidence, fixes, impact levels, and a prioritized action plan.
limitations: Requires a site URL, page samples, crawl exports, or user-provided analytics to produce specific evidence.
Cannot access private Search Console, analytics, or paid SEO tools unless the user provides data.
Schema detection may require a rendered browser, Rich Results Test, or Screaming Frog export.
Search rankings can change for reasons outside the audited site, including competitors and algorithm updates.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a SaaS traffic plateau
use_cases.description: Find crawl, page, content, and authority issues that limit organic growth for product-led websites.

use_cases.title: Review an e-commerce category section
use_cases.description: Check category depth, product duplication, schema needs, faceted navigation, and indexation controls.

use_cases.title: Improve an existing content hub
use_cases.description: Assess content freshness, topical coverage, internal linking, cannibalization, and search intent alignment.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Site Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when starting a first SEO review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my website for SEO issues. Start by asking for my URL, target keywords, recent changes, and Search Console access.

prompt_templates.title: Ranking Diagnosis
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when one page is underperforming for a target keyword.
prompt_templates.prompt: My page is stuck below top results for a keyword. Diagnose technical, on-page, content, and competitive causes.

prompt_templates.title: Full Technical and Content Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the user can share crawl or analytics evidence.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a full SEO audit using my crawl export and analytics notes. Prioritize indexation, Core Web Vitals, page optimization, and content gaps.

prompt_templates.title: International SEO Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the site serves multiple languages or regions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit our multilingual SEO setup. Check hreflang, locale canonicals, x-default, translated content quality, and international sitemap structure.

output_examples.input: A SaaS site has stagnant traffic and a few target keywords.
output_examples.output: The report identifies missing comparison pages, weak internal links, slow templates, and unclear keyword targeting. It ranks fixes by expected impact.

output_examples.input: A multilingual site has English and Arabic versions of the same pages.
output_examples.output: The audit checks self-referencing hreflang, x-default, locale canonicals, translated main content, and sitemap consistency.

output_examples.input: A product page ranks on page three for its main keyword.
output_examples.output: The diagnosis compares title alignment, heading structure, content depth, indexation status, canonical signals, and competitor coverage.

best_practices: Provide priority pages, keywords, competitors, recent changes, and any crawl or analytics exports before the audit.
Validate schema with rendered-page tools before claiming structured data is missing.
Fix crawlability and indexation blockers before broad content rewrites or link-building recommendations.
anti_patterns: Do not claim schema is missing based only on web_fetch or curl output.
Do not diagnose rankings without checking search intent, competitors, and page-level evidence.
Do not recommend broad content changes before checking crawlability, canonicals, redirects, and indexation.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Share the site URL, target pages, priority keywords, recent changes, competitors, and any Search Console or crawl data.

faq.question: Can this skill audit private analytics data?
faq.answer: It can analyze private data only when you provide exports, summaries, screenshots, or direct access through the active tool environment.

faq.question: Does it replace paid SEO tools?
faq.answer: No. It organizes analysis and recommendations, but paid crawl, rank, backlink, and log data can improve evidence quality.

faq.question: Can it check schema markup accurately?
faq.answer: Yes, but it should use rendered-page validation, Rich Results Test, or Screaming Frog when schema may be injected by JavaScript.

faq.question: Does it support international SEO?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes hreflang, x-default, locale canonical, sitemap, URL structure, and translated content checks.

faq.question: What does the final audit include?
faq.answer: It includes an executive summary, categorized findings, evidence, fixes, impact levels, priorities, and a staged action plan.
